title: SPI bus with chip select

implements.text: Byte transfers per chip select at the bus clock, modes 0 to 3, most or least significant bit first
A transfer to a chip select with no device answers 0xFF with an event, or fails under the fail policy

unsupported.text: Edge shapes and setup and hold times

knownFailureCases: Only the no-device paths have a test; a transfer to an attached device has none
